name: Check Point
description: Connect your own Check Point Security Management Server (or Multi-Domain Server) to manage hosts, networks, groups, TCP/UDP services, access control rules across layers, policy packages, and gateway inventory -- plus publish/discard of pending session changes, policy installation to gateways, bulk rule operations, and a Check Point estate health audit. Uses your own Management Server admin credentials, exchanged for a session id via the standard login endpoint -- nothing is hosted or proxied by Imperal beyond the request itself.

tools.name: connect_checkpoint
tools.description: Connect a Check Point Security Management Server (or Multi-Domain Server) by saving its host and admin credentials, after exchanging them once for a session id.

host.description: Check Point Management Server base URL, e.g. 'https://mgmt.company.com'.
host.title: Host

password.description: Management Server administrator password (used to obtain a session id, not stored).
password.title: Password

domain.description: Multi-Domain Security Management domain name -- leave empty for a standalone Management Server.
domain.title: Domain

label.description: Optional friendly name for this connection.
label.title: Label
